_note: Mail App: the sender check and Unsubscribe on each message (app/components/email-panel/SenderCheck.tsx).
verifiedTip: The email really came from {domain}: it passed the sender checks (SPF {spf}, DKIM {dkim}, DMARC {dmarc}).
failedTip: This email says it's from {domain}, but it failed that domain's own checks (SPF {spf}, DKIM {dkim}, DMARC {dmarc}). Be careful with links and attachments.
unknownTip: {domain} doesn't publish the checks that prove who sent its email (SPF {spf}, DKIM {dkim}, DMARC {dmarc}).
lookalikeTitle: This sender looks like {known}, but isn't
lookalike: The email is from {domain}, which is easy to mistake for {known}. Don't click links or open attachments unless you're sure it's genuine.
unsubscribed: Unsubscribed. It can take the sender a few days to stop.
unsubscribedBlocked: Unsubscribed and blocked. Anything else from {sender} goes to Spam.
opened: Their unsubscribe page is open in a new tab.
